# Array Introduction

#### Course: Learn C++ Basics

## Array Introduction

So far, we have mostly used a simple variable to store a single piece of data.

In this chapter, we will learn about arrays that allow us to work with multiple data at once.

Before we learn about arrays, let's understand why we need them.

Suppose you need to store the age of a hundred people. One way to do this is to create hundreds of variables to store the age of each individual. However, that will be a lengthy and tedious task.

Instead, what we can do is create a single array and store the age of a hundred people together.

![Arrays are a collection of data of the same time](data:image/png;base64,)

Now that you have a basic idea of why arrays are important, let's learn about it in detail.
